subject: Audit trace evidence: export format, retention, and sampling request
messages:
From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acmehealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence for SIG & SOC2 — logs and retention

Hi Hannah,

We're preparing for a SIG questionnaire (and an upcoming SOC 2 readiness review) and need a clear statement of what Redwood retains as audit/log evidence, plus export options. Specifically:

- Which event types are recorded for admin activity (console and API)?
- Retention windows for each event category (admin actions, system audit events, access logs).
- Export formats (CSV/JSON schema), whether exports include full request/response payloads or just metadata, and whether exports can be delivered to our S3.
- Any sampling or redaction policies you apply when creating evidence bundles.

Can you provide an example manifest and a short runbook so our auditors can validate the artifacts? We'd like a 90-day bundle initially, then instructions to request up to 12 months if needed.

Thanks — can we get this by EOD Friday so we can slot it into the auditor's scope?

Best,
Jane
Jane Smith
Security & Risk, Acme Health
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Aaron Lewis <aaron.lewis@appaudit.co>, laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence for SIG & SOC2 — logs and retention

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear list. High level answers below; attaching a compact manifest and the latest log schema as a starting point (log_schema_v2.json + evidence_manifest_20260915.csv).

Quick summary (details and runbook attached):
- Event categories we retain:
  * Admin control plane actions (user creation, role changes, permission grants/revocation, API key/secret lifecycle)
  * Deployment actions (model deploy, rollback, version pinning)
  * Authentication events (console login attempts, MFA changes, SSO assertions)
  * Data access events (export requests, snapshot/backup creation)
  * System audit events (service restarts, autoscale decisions, hardware errors)
  * Network/egress logs (large data egress operations initiated by admins)

- Retention windows:
  * Admin control plane: default 2 years (730 days) — configurable per-customer for Dedicated/Private.
  * Auth & access logs: 1 year (365 days).
  * System audit and infra telemetry: 90 days by default, archived up to 2 years on request.
  * Evidence bundles we produce for audits: we keep an immutable hash-indexed archive for 12 months after export.

- Export formats & contents:
  * Standard export: gzipped JSON lines (ndjson) containing one event per line; schema includes timestamp, event_id, actor_id (internal user id), actor_email (if applicable), action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, outcome, ip, user_agent, region, before/after metadata (when applicable).
  * CSV option: same fields flattened where feasible (attachments and large payloads are omitted).
  * Payloads: request/response bodies are excluded by default for PII protection; where auditors request payloads we provide a scoped export under an NDA with redaction controls.
  * Delivery: S3 PUT with temporary credentials (preferred), or secure Drive link if requested. We include a signed manifest (SHA256 checksums) for integrity verification.

- Sampling / redaction policy:
  * We do not sample admin control plane actions in production export bundles — admin events are delivered in full for audit scope.
  * For high-volume system telemetry (e.g., runtime traces), we can provide deterministic sampling slices (time-window + modulus on request_id) documented in the manifest.
  * PII redaction: email addresses are preserved only for admin actor fields; request/response bodies that may contain customer data are redacted unless a separate data export NDA is signed.

Next steps:
1) Confirm the exact date range for the 90-day bundle you want.
2) Confirm delivery preference (S3 bucket + role ARN preferred).
3) We'll produce the export with checksums and a short runbook for auditors (expected turnaround: 2 business days after confirmation).

Attaching: log_schema_v2.json (event schema), evidence_manifest_20260915.csv (example manifest), s3_export_instructions.pdf (how to grant us a temporary write role).

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if Aaron's team needs a walkthrough.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
